scope: Single client; prototype complete scan, rule-based unique-equality plan, optional previous planned binary, explicit index lookup, and SQLite expression-index lookup. SQLite returns JSON text; the prototype decodes and validates JSON. Scan runs are omitted when the collection exceeds the 1024-document limit. Preparation and recovery verification are outside operation timers but included in telemetry. Not a concurrency, power-loss or universal ranking.
